verdicts.reason: A turns the big circle into a squashed ellipse, so the shape is visibly distorted. Its '30% OFF' runs almost edge to edge and crowds the right margin. The logo jumps to the top-right corner, the product sits off-centre to the left with an orphaned circle beside it, and the legal line runs across the lower-left circle and is cramped at the bottom. B keeps everything centred and on a clear axis, with the circles undistorted and the brand intact. However, the product is pushed below the CTA, which breaks reading order, and the product sits on an awkward cluster of overlapping circles. The CTA is small compared with the headline, and the legal text is tiny.
